name: datatree
description: Local disk usage analysis for humans and AI agents. Scan folders, query size/allocated, search, export CSV, and delete only after a two-step confirm.

interface.shortDescription: Disk usage MCP + skills for scan, search, and confirmed cleanup.
interface.longDescription: Scan local folders with DataTree (NTFS MFT or parallel walk), query allocated size, search with *.iso / <100m / a>=1g, export CSV, and delete only after plan_delete + confirm_delete.
defaultPrompt: Scan this workspace and list the 20 largest files by allocated size.
Find files matching *.iso or a>=1g under the current project.
Show disk volumes and which engine DataTree would use (MFT vs Walk).
Prepare a trash plan for obvious junk, then wait for me to confirm.
